title: Binte Zehra Pe Musibat
body:
Binte Zehra Pe Musibat Ki Ghadi Hai Abbas
Berida Khalqe Khuda (×2)
Dekh Rahi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Qaidiyon Ko Jo Rehayi Ki Qabar Deti Thi (×2)
Aaj Zinda Me Wahi Qaid Huyi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Baarha Roke Jise Shere Khuda Chuumtey The (×2)
Reesma Ab Unhi Shano Me Bandhi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Saat Sau Kursi Nashi Baithey Hai Kya Ghurbat Hai (×2)
Binte Zehra Sare Darbaar Khadi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pehki Jaane Lagi Sadke Ki Khajooren Ham Par (×2)
Kis Kadar Karb Zada Aale Nabi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dam Ghuta Jaata Hai Gardan Ki Rasan Kasti Hai (×2)
Kya Jafa Baali Sakina Pe Huyi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ek Bhatija Hai Jo Bemaar Hai Mazloom Bi Hai (×2)
Iske Bi Pau Me Zanjeer Padi Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ghar Se Bahar Nahi Rakhey They Khadam Bhi Jisne (×2)
Qaid Hokar Woh Suye Shaam Chali Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jis Taraf Dekho Tamashayi Nazar Aatey Hai (×2)
Dekhlo Mehve Buka Binte Ali Hai Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Hai Tajamul Bi Tera Aur Tera Mir Hilal (×2)
Zindagi Waqf E Aza Dono Ne Ki Hai Abbas
